## Ballpoint Pen Parts

The interior of a ballpoint pen consists of seven main parts: the spring, thrust device, thrust tube, reservoir, ball, socket, and ink. The exterior includes the tip, rubber grip, barrel, and grip.

Ballpoint pens utilize a replaceable ink cartridge designed for a retractable mechanism. Most ballpoint pens include a spring to provide tension for the retraction mechanism.

The ballpoint pen design incorporates a tiny ball bearing in its tip that rotates as the pen moves along the paper, picking up ink from the ink cartridge and leaving it on the paper.
